name: Amity Park
source:
Amity Park is a Dating Sim/Visual Novel game based on the notable Nickelodeon television show, Danny Phantom. The game is a bit of a retelling of the show, most notably with the introduction of explicit adult themes and suggestive content.

You play as Danny Fenton, a boy who has accidentally been gifted amazing ghost powers due to his father's incredible ghost dimensional gateway. He must now use his powers to defend his town from other rampant ghosts, save the girl next door, and still turn in his homework on time.

With plenty of ghosts to meet, with just as many cute girls to explore, Amity Park invites you to Go Ghost.
translation:
《Amity Park》是一款以尼克兒童頻道知名動畫《幻影丹尼》為基礎的戀愛模擬／視覺小說遊戲。本作在一定程度上重新講述了原作故事，最顯著的變化是加入了明確的成人主題與暗示性內容。

你將扮演丹尼・芬頓，一個因父親製造的神奇幽靈異次元通道而意外獲得強大幽靈能力的少年。如今，他必須運用能力，保護小鎮免受四處作亂的幽靈侵襲，救下鄰家女孩，還得按時交作業。

這裡有許多幽靈等你結識，也有同樣多的可愛女孩等你瞭解。《Amity Park》邀你化身幽靈，展開冒險。
